scope.method: Read-only inspection of the sealed VPR contract and retained VTC/FPCR JSON receipts and transcript; static text accounting only.

source_binding.binding_status: The sealed VPR verifier passed against the exact quoted commit/tree. This cross-examination treats only that pair as observed; it does not normalize either rejected FPC tuple.

parser_and_vector_findings.ordered_discovery_vector: The retained FPCR discovery receipt exposes only count, first ID, last ID, and an ordered-ID digest. It contains no ordered_ids vector. The VTC discovery receipt also contains no ordered_ids vector. A digest cannot be inverted into the required unique ordered set, so no retained input permits the sealed parser to establish coverage of all 1,059 IDs.

transcript_header_accounting.interpretation: Static header accounting is not an outcome ledger and cannot infer the missing reported test or assign it an ID.

terminal_label_ambiguity.finding: The sealed state machine permits warning lines only while a header is awaiting a terminal label, and accepts a custom label only when explicitly declared. Here warning/reason text is attached on the header line; no custom label declaration binds those strings. Treating them as terminal outcomes, silently stripping them, or converting reason-bearing skipped labels to skipped would invent semantics.

parser_and_vector_findings.reason: Neither an ordered discovery vector nor a transcript that cleanly binds every reported outcome through the sealed vocabulary is retained. The necessary exactly-once mapping cannot be proven.

authority_and_candidate_findings.finding: Even a successful ledger could reduce provenance uncertainty only. An inconclusive ledger supplies no new authority for implementation, CI, candidate execution, promotion, performance, or knowledge BASELINE-000 retry.
